solution: (5x + 6) / (7x + 6) = 3/4 gives 20x + 24 = 21x + 18, so x = 6 and the smaller number is 30.

solution: Relative speed = 300 / 20 = 15 m/s = 54 km/h, so the train's speed = 54 + 6 = 60 km/h.
